name: Robert Biedroń, Nikolas Farantouris - § 47
title: REPORT on implementation and delivery of the Sustainable Development Goals in view of the 2025 High-Level Political Forum
part_text: Regrets the regression of LGBTIQ+ rights and the transphobia that threatens gender equality; denounces the fact that, between 2021 and 2022, just three anti-LGBTIQ+ organisations reported USD 1 billion in income, while 8 000 global LGBTIQ+ grantees received USD 905 million between them[[40]](#footnote-40); warns of the worrying increase in anti-gender financing that aims to counteract the progressive achievements of women’s and LGBTIQ+ rights of the past decades;
